description: A journal entry: one moment, made of ordered blocks of text, photos, video and audio.

main.description: A journal entry: one moment, made of ordered blocks of text, photos, video and audio. An entry too large for one sealed record isn't written: the device shows a RecordTooLarge sync error naming the entry, so the person can shorten or split it, and never trims it.

blocks.description: The entry's content, in reading order.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the device was in when the moment was captured, such as America/Chicago. Present with or without a location, so the entry's local time can be shown as it was. Stored as written: a zone newer than the reader's time zone data is still kept.

capturedOn.description: The kind of device the moment was captured on. Set once at capture and never edited. Absent when it wasn't recorded.

capturedDuring.description: What the person was doing when the moment was captured, while activity awareness was on. Set once at capture and never edited. Absent when nothing was under way or it wasn't recorded. Sleep is never recorded.

createdAt.description: When the moment happened or was first written down.

id.description: Identifier of the block, unique within its entry. Transcripts and other records refer to a block by this value.

text.description: The text. The app doesn't limit its length; a device refuses to write a longer text and shows a sync error naming the field, rather than cutting it short. Captions, journal titles, place names and correction labels share these limits and this rule.

format.description: How to interpret the text. Defaults to markdown, which is what LogDate's editor writes.

id.description: Identifier of the block, unique within its entry. Transcripts and other records refer to a block by this value.

media.description: The photo. Absent when the file is unavailable: no device has its bytes, such as after restoring an archive that didn't include them. The rest of the block is kept, and apps show that the photo is missing.

caption.description: What the person wrote about the photo, in markdown.

presentation.description: How the photo is framed when the entry is shown. Defaults to edgeToEdge.

id.description: Identifier of the block, unique within its entry. Transcripts and other records refer to a block by this value.

media.description: The video. Absent when the file is unavailable: no device has its bytes, such as after restoring an archive that didn't include them. The rest of the block is kept, and apps show that the video is missing.

caption.description: What the person wrote about the video, in markdown.

id.description: Identifier of the block, unique within its entry. Transcripts and other records refer to a block by this value.

media.description: The recording. Absent when the file is unavailable: no device has its bytes, such as after restoring an archive that didn't include them. The length, caption and transcript are kept, and apps show that the recording is missing.

caption.description: What the person wrote about the recording, in markdown.

transcript.description: The transcript of this recording (app.logdate.journal.transcript), when one exists. Its record key is this entry's key and this block's id joined by a colon.
